133  @Test
134  public void testPrefetchDoesntOverwork() throws Exception {
135    conf.setLong(BUCKET_CACHE_SIZE_KEY, 200);
136    blockCache = BlockCacheFactory.createBlockCache(conf);
137    cacheConf = new CacheConfig(conf, blockCache);
138    Path storeFile = writeStoreFile("TestPrefetchDoesntOverwork", 100);
139    // Prefetches the file blocks
140    LOG.debug("First read should prefetch the blocks.");
141    readStoreFile(storeFile);
142    BucketCache bc = BucketCache.getBucketCacheFromCacheConfig(cacheConf).get();
143    // Our file should have 6 DATA blocks. We should wait for all of them to be cached
144    Waiter.waitFor(conf, 300, () -> bc.getBackingMap().size() == 6);
145    Map<BlockCacheKey, BucketEntry> snapshot = ImmutableMap.copyOf(bc.getBackingMap());
146    LruBlockCache l1 = (LruBlockCache) ((CombinedBlockCache) blockCache).getFirstLevelCache();
147    assertEquals(1, l1.getBlockCount());
148    // Removes the meta block from L1 cache
149    l1.clearCache();
150    // Reads file again. Checks we are not prefetching data blocks again,
151    // but fetch back the meta block
152    LOG.debug("Second read, prefetch should run, without altering bucket cache state,"
153      + " only the meta block should be fetched again.");
154    readStoreFile(storeFile);
155    // Makes sure the bucketcache entries have not changed
156    snapshot.entrySet().forEach(e -> {
157      BucketEntry entry = bc.getBackingMap().get(e.getKey());
158      assertNotNull(entry);
159      assertEquals(e.getValue().getCachedTime(), entry.getCachedTime());
160    });
161    assertEquals(1, l1.getBlockCount());
162    // forcibly removes first block from the bc backing map, in order to cause it to be cached again
163    BlockCacheKey key = snapshot.keySet().stream().findFirst().get();
164    LOG.debug("removing block {}", key);
165    bc.getBackingMap().remove(key);
166    bc.getFullyCachedFiles().get().remove(storeFile.getName());
167    assertTrue(snapshot.size() > bc.getBackingMap().size());
168    LOG.debug("Third read should prefetch again, as we removed one block for the file.");
169    readStoreFile(storeFile);
170    Waiter.waitFor(conf, 300, () -> snapshot.size() == bc.getBackingMap().size());
171    assertTrue(snapshot.get(key).getCachedTime() < bc.getBackingMap().get(key).getCachedTime());
172  }

174  @Test
175  public void testPrefetchRefsAfterSplit() throws Exception {
176    conf.setLong(BUCKET_CACHE_SIZE_KEY, 200);
177    blockCache = BlockCacheFactory.createBlockCache(conf);
178    cacheConf = new CacheConfig(conf, blockCache);
179
180    Path tableDir = new Path(TEST_UTIL.getDataTestDir(), "testPrefetchRefsAfterSplit");
181    RegionInfo region = RegionInfoBuilder.newBuilder(TableName.valueOf(tableDir.getName())).build();
182    Path regionDir = new Path(tableDir, region.getEncodedName());
183    Path cfDir = new Path(regionDir, "cf");
184    HRegionFileSystem regionFS =
185      HRegionFileSystem.createRegionOnFileSystem(conf, fs, tableDir, region);
186    Path storeFile = writeStoreFile(100, cfDir);
187    StoreFileTracker sft = StoreFileTrackerFactory.create(conf, true,
188      StoreContext.getBuilder().withRegionFileSystem(regionFS).withFamilyStoreDirectoryPath(cfDir)
189        .withCacheConfig(cacheConf).build());
190    // Prefetches the file blocks
191    LOG.debug("First read should prefetch the blocks.");
192    readStoreFile(storeFile);
193    BucketCache bc = BucketCache.getBucketCacheFromCacheConfig(cacheConf).get();
194    // Our file should have 6 DATA blocks. We should wait for all of them to be cached
195    Waiter.waitFor(conf, 300, () -> bc.getBackingMap().size() == 6);
196
197    // split the file and return references to the original file
198    Random rand = ThreadLocalRandom.current();
199    byte[] splitPoint = RandomKeyValueUtil.randomOrderedKey(rand, 50);
200    HStoreFile file = new HStoreFile(fs, storeFile, conf, cacheConf, BloomType.NONE, true, sft);
201    Path ref = regionFS.splitStoreFile(region, "cf", file, splitPoint, false,
202      new ConstantSizeRegionSplitPolicy(), sft);
203    HStoreFile refHsf = new HStoreFile(this.fs, ref, conf, cacheConf, BloomType.NONE, true, sft);
204    // starts reader for the ref. The ref should resolve to the original file blocks
205    // and not duplicate blocks in the cache.
206    refHsf.initReader();
207    HFile.Reader reader = refHsf.getReader().getHFileReader();
208    while (!reader.prefetchComplete()) {
209      // Sleep for a bit
210      Thread.sleep(1000);
211    }
212    // the ref file blocks keys should actually resolve to the referred file blocks,
213    // so we should not see additional blocks in the cache.
214    Waiter.waitFor(conf, 300, () -> bc.getBackingMap().size() == 6);
215
216    BlockCacheKey refCacheKey = new BlockCacheKey(ref.getName(), 0);
217    Cacheable result = bc.getBlock(refCacheKey, true, false, true);
218    assertNotNull(result);
219    BlockCacheKey fileCacheKey = new BlockCacheKey(file.getPath().getName(), 0);
220    assertEquals(result, bc.getBlock(fileCacheKey, true, false, true));
221    assertNull(bc.getBackingMap().get(refCacheKey));
222    assertNotNull(bc.getBlockForReference(refCacheKey));
223  }

225  @Test
226  public void testPrefetchInterruptOnCapacity() throws Exception {
227    conf.setLong(BUCKET_CACHE_SIZE_KEY, 1);
228    conf.set(BUCKET_CACHE_BUCKETS_KEY, "3072");
229    conf.setDouble("hbase.bucketcache.acceptfactor", 0.98);
230    conf.setDouble("hbase.bucketcache.minfactor", 0.98);
231    conf.setDouble("hbase.bucketcache.extrafreefactor", 0.0);
232    conf.setLong(QUEUE_ADDITION_WAIT_TIME, 100);
233    blockCache = BlockCacheFactory.createBlockCache(conf);
234    cacheConf = new CacheConfig(conf, blockCache);
235    Path storeFile = writeStoreFile("testPrefetchInterruptOnCapacity", 10000);
236    // Prefetches the file blocks
237    LOG.debug("First read should prefetch the blocks.");
238    createReaderAndWaitForPrefetchInterruption(storeFile);
239    Waiter.waitFor(conf, (PrefetchExecutor.getPrefetchDelay() + 1000),
240      () -> PrefetchExecutor.isCompleted(storeFile));
241    BucketCache bc = BucketCache.getBucketCacheFromCacheConfig(cacheConf).get();
242    long evictedFirstPrefetch = bc.getStats().getEvictedCount();
243    HFile.Reader reader = createReaderAndWaitForPrefetchInterruption(storeFile);
244    assertEquals(evictedFirstPrefetch, bc.getStats().getEvictedCount());
245    HFileScanner scanner = reader.getScanner(conf, true, true);
246    scanner.seekTo();
247    while (scanner.next()) {
248      // do a full scan to force some evictions
249      LOG.trace("Iterating the full scan to evict some blocks");
250    }
251    scanner.close();
252    Waiter.waitFor(conf, 5000, () -> {
253      for (BlockingQueue<BucketCache.RAMQueueEntry> queue : bc.writerQueues) {
254        if (!queue.isEmpty()) {
255          return false;
256        }
257      }
258      return true;
259    });
260    // The scanner should had triggered at least 3x evictions from the prefetch,
261    // as we try cache each block without interruption.
262    assertTrue(bc.getStats().getEvictedCount() > evictedFirstPrefetch);
263  }

265  @Test
266  public void testPrefetchDoesntInterruptInMemoryOnCapacity() throws Exception {
267    conf.setLong(BUCKET_CACHE_SIZE_KEY, 1);
268    conf.set(BUCKET_CACHE_BUCKETS_KEY, "3072");
269    conf.setDouble("hbase.bucketcache.acceptfactor", 0.98);
270    conf.setDouble("hbase.bucketcache.minfactor", 0.98);
271    conf.setDouble("hbase.bucketcache.extrafreefactor", 0.0);
272    blockCache = BlockCacheFactory.createBlockCache(conf);
273    ColumnFamilyDescriptor family =
274      ColumnFamilyDescriptorBuilder.newBuilder(Bytes.toBytes("f")).setInMemory(true).build();
275    cacheConf = new CacheConfig(conf, family, blockCache, ByteBuffAllocator.HEAP);
276    Path storeFile = writeStoreFile("testPrefetchDoesntInterruptInMemoryOnCapacity", 10000);
277    // Prefetches the file blocks
278    LOG.debug("First read should prefetch the blocks.");
279    createReaderAndWaitForPrefetchInterruption(storeFile);
280    BucketCache bc = BucketCache.getBucketCacheFromCacheConfig(cacheConf).get();
281    Waiter.waitFor(conf, 1000, () -> PrefetchExecutor.isCompleted(storeFile));
282    long evictions = bc.getStats().getEvictedCount();
283    LOG.debug("Total evicted at this point: {}", evictions);
284    // creates another reader, now that cache is full, no block would fit and prefetch should not
285    // trigger any new evictions
286    createReaderAndWaitForPrefetchInterruption(storeFile);
287    assertEquals(evictions, bc.getStats().getEvictedCount());
288  }

290  @Test
291  public void testPrefetchRunNoEvictions() throws Exception {
292    conf.setLong(BUCKET_CACHE_SIZE_KEY, 1);
293    conf.set(BUCKET_CACHE_BUCKETS_KEY, "3072");
294    conf.setDouble("hbase.bucketcache.acceptfactor", 0.98);
295    conf.setDouble("hbase.bucketcache.minfactor", 0.98);
296    conf.setDouble("hbase.bucketcache.extrafreefactor", 0.0);
297    conf.setLong(QUEUE_ADDITION_WAIT_TIME, 100);
298    blockCache = BlockCacheFactory.createBlockCache(conf);
299    cacheConf = new CacheConfig(conf, blockCache);
300    Path storeFile = writeStoreFile("testPrefetchRunNoEvictions", 10000);
301    // Prefetches the file blocks
302    createReaderAndWaitForPrefetchInterruption(storeFile);
303    Waiter.waitFor(conf, (PrefetchExecutor.getPrefetchDelay() + 1000),
304      () -> PrefetchExecutor.isCompleted(storeFile));
305    BucketCache bc = BucketCache.getBucketCacheFromCacheConfig(cacheConf).get();
306    // Wait until all cache writer queues are empty
307    Waiter.waitFor(conf, 5000, () -> {
308      for (BlockingQueue<BucketCache.RAMQueueEntry> queue : bc.writerQueues) {
309        if (!queue.isEmpty()) {
310          return false;
311        }
312      }
313      return true;
314    });
315    // With the wait time configuration, prefetch should trigger no evictions once it reaches
316    // cache capacity
317    assertEquals(0, bc.getStats().getEvictedCount());
318  }

320  @Test
321  public void testPrefetchRunTriggersEvictions() throws Exception {
322    conf.setLong(BUCKET_CACHE_SIZE_KEY, 1);
323    conf.set(BUCKET_CACHE_BUCKETS_KEY, "3072");
324    conf.setDouble("hbase.bucketcache.acceptfactor", 0.98);
325    conf.setDouble("hbase.bucketcache.minfactor", 0.98);
326    conf.setDouble("hbase.bucketcache.extrafreefactor", 0.0);
327    conf.setLong(QUEUE_ADDITION_WAIT_TIME, 0);
328    blockCache = BlockCacheFactory.createBlockCache(conf);
329    cacheConf = new CacheConfig(conf, blockCache);
330    // Use 15000 KVs to ensure file reliably exceeds 1MB cache capacity even with size variance
331    Path storeFile = writeStoreFile("testPrefetchRunTriggersEvictions", 15000);
332    // Prefetches the file blocks
333    createReaderAndWaitForPrefetchInterruption(storeFile);
334    Waiter.waitFor(conf, (PrefetchExecutor.getPrefetchDelay() + 1000),
335      () -> PrefetchExecutor.isCompleted(storeFile));
336    BucketCache bc = BucketCache.getBucketCacheFromCacheConfig(cacheConf).get();
337    // Wait until all cache writer queues are empty
338    Waiter.waitFor(conf, 5000, () -> {
339      for (BlockingQueue<BucketCache.RAMQueueEntry> queue : bc.writerQueues) {
340        if (!queue.isEmpty()) {
341          return false;
342        }
343      }
344      return true;
345    });
346    // With no wait time configuration, prefetch will either trigger evictions when reaching
347    // cache capacity, or have failed inserts when the writer queue fills faster than it drains.
348    // Both outcomes are valid - test should only fail if NEITHER happens, which would indicate
349    // a problem with the capacity management logic.
350    long evictions = bc.getStats().getEvictedCount();
351    long failedInserts = bc.getStats().getFailedInserts();
352    assertTrue(
353      "Expected either evictions or failed inserts to demonstrate capacity management, "
354        + "but got evictions=" + evictions + ", failedInserts=" + failedInserts,
355      evictions > 0 || failedInserts > 0);
356  }

358  @Test
359  public void testPrefetchMetricProgress() throws Exception {
360    conf.setLong(BUCKET_CACHE_SIZE_KEY, 200);
361    blockCache = BlockCacheFactory.createBlockCache(conf);
362    cacheConf = new CacheConfig(conf, blockCache);
363    Path storeFile = writeStoreFile("testPrefetchMetricsProgress", 100);
364    // Prefetches the file blocks
365    LOG.debug("First read should prefetch the blocks.");
366    readStoreFile(storeFile);
367    String regionName = storeFile.getParent().getParent().getName();
368    BucketCache bc = BucketCache.getBucketCacheFromCacheConfig(cacheConf).get();
369    MutableLong regionCachedSize = new MutableLong(0);
370    // Our file should have 6 DATA blocks. We should wait for all of them to be cached
371    Waiter.waitFor(conf, 300, () -> {
372      if (bc.getBackingMap().size() > 0) {
373        long currentSize = bc.getRegionCachedInfo().get().get(regionName);
374        assertTrue(regionCachedSize.getValue() <= currentSize);
375        LOG.debug("Logging progress of region caching: {}", currentSize);
376        regionCachedSize.setValue(currentSize);
377      }
378      return bc.getBackingMap().size() == 6;
379    });
380  }

382  @Test
383  public void testPrefetchMetricProgressForLinks() throws Exception {
384    conf.setLong(BUCKET_CACHE_SIZE_KEY, 200);
385    blockCache = BlockCacheFactory.createBlockCache(conf);
386    cacheConf = new CacheConfig(conf, blockCache);
387    final RegionInfo hri =
388      RegionInfoBuilder.newBuilder(TableName.valueOf(name.getMethodName())).build();
389    // force temp data in hbase/target/test-data instead of /tmp/hbase-xxxx/
390    Configuration testConf = new Configuration(this.conf);
391    Path testDir = TEST_UTIL.getDataTestDir(name.getMethodName());
392    CommonFSUtils.setRootDir(testConf, testDir);
393    Path tableDir = CommonFSUtils.getTableDir(testDir, hri.getTable());
394    RegionInfo region = RegionInfoBuilder.newBuilder(TableName.valueOf(tableDir.getName())).build();
395    Path regionDir = new Path(tableDir, region.getEncodedName());
396    Path cfDir = new Path(regionDir, "cf");
397    HRegionFileSystem regionFS =
398      HRegionFileSystem.createRegionOnFileSystem(testConf, fs, tableDir, region);
399    Path storeFile = writeStoreFile(100, cfDir);
400    // Prefetches the file blocks
401    LOG.debug("First read should prefetch the blocks.");
402    readStoreFile(storeFile);
403    BucketCache bc = BucketCache.getBucketCacheFromCacheConfig(cacheConf).get();
404    // Our file should have 6 DATA blocks. We should wait for all of them to be cached
405    Waiter.waitFor(testConf, 300, () -> bc.getBackingMap().size() == 6);
406    long cachedSize = bc.getRegionCachedInfo().get().get(region.getEncodedName());
407
408    final RegionInfo dstHri =
409      RegionInfoBuilder.newBuilder(TableName.valueOf(name.getMethodName())).build();
410    HRegionFileSystem dstRegionFs = HRegionFileSystem.createRegionOnFileSystem(testConf, fs,
411      CommonFSUtils.getTableDir(testDir, dstHri.getTable()), dstHri);
412
413    Path dstPath = new Path(regionFS.getTableDir(), new Path(dstHri.getRegionNameAsString(), "cf"));
414
415    Path linkFilePath =
416      new Path(dstPath, HFileLink.createHFileLinkName(region, storeFile.getName()));
417
418    StoreFileTracker sft = StoreFileTrackerFactory.create(testConf, false,
419      StoreContext.getBuilder().withFamilyStoreDirectoryPath(dstPath)
420        .withColumnFamilyDescriptor(ColumnFamilyDescriptorBuilder.of("cf"))
421        .withRegionFileSystem(dstRegionFs).build());
422    sft.createHFileLink(hri.getTable(), hri.getEncodedName(), storeFile.getName(), true);
423    StoreFileInfo sfi = sft.getStoreFileInfo(linkFilePath, true);
424
425    HStoreFile hsf = new HStoreFile(sfi, BloomType.NONE, cacheConf);
426    assertTrue(sfi.isLink());
427    hsf.initReader();
428    HFile.Reader reader = hsf.getReader().getHFileReader();
429    while (!reader.prefetchComplete()) {
430      // Sleep for a bit
431      Thread.sleep(1000);
432    }
433    // HFileLink use the path of the target file to create a reader, so it should resolve to the
434    // already cached blocks and not insert new blocks in the cache.
435    Waiter.waitFor(testConf, 300, () -> bc.getBackingMap().size() == 6);
436
437    assertEquals(cachedSize, (long) bc.getRegionCachedInfo().get().get(region.getEncodedName()));
438  }

440  @Test
441  public void testPrefetchMetricProgressForLinksToArchived() throws Exception {
442    conf.setLong(BUCKET_CACHE_SIZE_KEY, 200);
443    blockCache = BlockCacheFactory.createBlockCache(conf);
444    cacheConf = new CacheConfig(conf, blockCache);
445
446    // force temp data in hbase/target/test-data instead of /tmp/hbase-xxxx/
447    Configuration testConf = new Configuration(this.conf);
448    Path testDir = TEST_UTIL.getDataTestDir(name.getMethodName());
449    CommonFSUtils.setRootDir(testConf, testDir);
450
451    final RegionInfo hri =
452      RegionInfoBuilder.newBuilder(TableName.valueOf(name.getMethodName())).build();
453    Path tableDir = CommonFSUtils.getTableDir(testDir, hri.getTable());
454    RegionInfo region = RegionInfoBuilder.newBuilder(TableName.valueOf(tableDir.getName())).build();
455    Path regionDir = new Path(tableDir, region.getEncodedName());
456    Path cfDir = new Path(regionDir, "cf");
457
458    Path storeFile = writeStoreFile(100, cfDir);
459    // Prefetches the file blocks
460    LOG.debug("First read should prefetch the blocks.");
461    readStoreFile(storeFile);
462    BucketCache bc = BucketCache.getBucketCacheFromCacheConfig(cacheConf).get();
463    // Our file should have 6 DATA blocks. We should wait for all of them to be cached
464    Waiter.waitFor(testConf, 300, () -> bc.getBackingMap().size() == 6);
465    long cachedSize = bc.getRegionCachedInfo().get().get(region.getEncodedName());
466
467    // create another file, but in the archive dir, hence it won't be cached
468    Path archiveRoot = new Path(testDir, "archive");
469    Path archiveTableDir = CommonFSUtils.getTableDir(archiveRoot, hri.getTable());
470    Path archiveRegionDir = new Path(archiveTableDir, region.getEncodedName());

472    Path archivedFile = writeStoreFile(100, archiveCfDir);

474    final RegionInfo testRegion =

476    final HRegionFileSystem testRegionFs = HRegionFileSystem.createRegionOnFileSystem(testConf, fs,
477      CommonFSUtils.getTableDir(testDir, testRegion.getTable()), testRegion);
478    // Just create a link to the archived file
479    Path dstPath = new Path(tableDir, new Path(testRegion.getEncodedName(), "cf"));
480
481    Path linkFilePath =
482      new Path(dstPath, HFileLink.createHFileLinkName(region, archivedFile.getName()));
483
484    StoreFileTracker sft = StoreFileTrackerFactory.create(testConf, false,
485      StoreContext.getBuilder().withFamilyStoreDirectoryPath(dstPath)
486        .withColumnFamilyDescriptor(ColumnFamilyDescriptorBuilder.of("cf"))
487        .withRegionFileSystem(testRegionFs).build());

489    StoreFileInfo sfi = sft.getStoreFileInfo(linkFilePath, true);

492    assertTrue(sfi.isLink());
493    hsf.initReader();
494    HFile.Reader reader = hsf.getReader().getHFileReader();
495    while (!reader.prefetchComplete()) {
496      // Sleep for a bit
497      Thread.sleep(1000);
498    }
499    // HFileLink use the path of the target file to create a reader, but the target file is in the
500    // archive, so it wasn't cached previously and should be cached when we open the link.
501    Waiter.waitFor(testConf, 300, () -> bc.getBackingMap().size() == 12);
502    // cached size for the region of target file shouldn't change
503    assertEquals(cachedSize, (long) bc.getRegionCachedInfo().get().get(region.getEncodedName()));
504    // cached size for the region with link pointing to archive dir shouldn't be updated
505    assertNull(bc.getRegionCachedInfo().get().get(testRegion.getEncodedName()));
506  }
507
508  private void readStoreFile(Path storeFilePath) throws Exception {
509    readStoreFile(storeFilePath, (r, o) -> {
510      HFileBlock block = null;
511      try {
512        block = r.readBlock(o, -1, false, true, false, true, null, null);
513      } catch (IOException e) {
514        fail(e.getMessage());
515      }
516      return block;
517    }, (key, block) -> {
518      boolean isCached = blockCache.getBlock(key, true, false, true) != null;
519      if (
520        block.getBlockType() == BlockType.DATA || block.getBlockType() == BlockType.ROOT_INDEX
521          || block.getBlockType() == BlockType.INTERMEDIATE_INDEX
522      ) {
523        assertTrue(isCached);
524      }
525    });
526  }
527
528  private void readStoreFile(Path storeFilePath,
529    BiFunction<HFile.Reader, Long, HFileBlock> readFunction,
530    BiConsumer<BlockCacheKey, HFileBlock> validationFunction) throws Exception {
531    // Open the file
532    HFile.Reader reader = HFile.createReader(fs, storeFilePath, cacheConf, true, conf);
533
534    while (!reader.prefetchComplete()) {
535      // Sleep for a bit
536      Thread.sleep(1000);
537    }
538    long offset = 0;
539    long sizeForDataBlocks = 0;
540    while (offset < reader.getTrailer().getLoadOnOpenDataOffset()) {
541      HFileBlock block = readFunction.apply(reader, offset);
542      BlockCacheKey blockCacheKey = new BlockCacheKey(reader.getName(), offset);
543      validationFunction.accept(blockCacheKey, block);
544      offset += block.getOnDiskSizeWithHeader();
545    }
546  }
547
548  private HFile.Reader createReaderAndWaitForPrefetchInterruption(Path storeFilePath)
549    throws Exception {
550    // Open the file
551    HFile.Reader reader = HFile.createReader(fs, storeFilePath, cacheConf, true, conf);
552
553    while (!reader.prefetchComplete()) {
554      // Sleep for a bit
555      Thread.sleep(1000);
556    }
557    assertEquals(0, BucketCache.getBucketCacheFromCacheConfig(cacheConf).get().getFullyCachedFiles()
558      .get().size());
559
560    return reader;
561  }

576
577  private Path writeStoreFile(HFileContext context, int numKVs, Path regionCFDir)
578    throws IOException {
579    StoreFileWriter sfw = new StoreFileWriter.Builder(conf, cacheConf, fs)
580      .withOutputDir(regionCFDir).withFileContext(context).build();
581    Random rand = ThreadLocalRandom.current();
582    final int rowLen = 32;
583    for (int i = 0; i < numKVs; ++i) {
584      byte[] k = RandomKeyValueUtil.randomOrderedKey(rand, i);
585      byte[] v = RandomKeyValueUtil.randomValue(rand);
586      int cfLen = rand.nextInt(k.length - rowLen + 1);
587      KeyValue kv = new KeyValue(k, 0, rowLen, k, rowLen, cfLen, k, rowLen + cfLen,
588        k.length - rowLen - cfLen, rand.nextLong(), generateKeyType(rand), v, 0, v.length);
589      sfw.append(kv);
590    }
591
592    sfw.close();
593    return sfw.getPath();
594  }
595
596  public static KeyValue.Type generateKeyType(Random rand) {
597    if (rand.nextBoolean()) {
598      // Let's make half of KVs puts.
599      return KeyValue.Type.Put;
600    } else {
601      KeyValue.Type keyType = KeyValue.Type.values()[1 + rand.nextInt(NUM_VALID_KEY_TYPES)];
602      if (keyType == KeyValue.Type.Minimum || keyType == KeyValue.Type.Maximum) {
603        throw new RuntimeException("Generated an invalid key type: " + keyType + ". "
604          + "Probably the layout of KeyValue.Type has changed.");
605      }
606      return keyType;
607    }
608  }
609}
